title: スプリンターズSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes. The race opens with…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An all-star video proposed by Curren Chan! The crowd's reaction rivals that of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The special opening video stars Hishi Akebono, Taiki Shuttle, and Sakura Bakushin O, whose combined cuteness doubles the excitement!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the showdown for the top. Not even Curren Chan can hide her nervousness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I encourage her with the most important words she can hear—that she's the cutest—and she heads off to the race beaming.
